scenarios.name: Riverbank Village Flood Response
scenarios.description: A rising tributary threatens three wards. Warn and evacuate before the flood crests, protect people during it, then lead the recovery: clean water, medical care, power, roads and a safe return home.
scenarios.hook: A monsoon tributary is rising beside three wards. Warn, evacuate and protect the bund, then lead the recovery.

npcs.name: Sarpanch Ramesh
npcs.initial_dialogue: Water is swelling rapidly near Ward 1. The villagers look to us for clear instructions. Should we issue a formal alert?

npcs.name: Officer Sunita
npcs.initial_dialogue: We have two motorized rescue boats and three transport trucks primed at the depot. Sandbagging supplies are ready.

npcs.name: Mohan
npcs.initial_dialogue: My parents have mobility constraints. Please prioritize evacuation transport for our elders before the causeway goes underwater.

npcs.name: Nurse Kavita
npcs.initial_dialogue: If people stay in the shelter for long, we must think about drinking water and medicines.

npcs.name: Ms. Desai
npcs.initial_dialogue: The district can send a convoy with boats, trucks and relief, but it takes time to arrive.

scenarios.name: Cyclone at Machhiwada
scenarios.description: A severe cyclone is heading for a fishing village. The storm surge will push the sea over the sea wall. Evacuate before landfall, call the fishing boats home, and manage a crowded cyclone shelter.
scenarios.hook: Landfall is hours away, fishing boats are still at sea and the cyclone shelter cannot hold everyone.

npcs.name: Sarpanch Ganesh
npcs.initial_dialogue: Eight of our boats went out before the warning. Their families are on the beach asking what to do.

npcs.name: Coast Guard Petty Officer Joseph
npcs.initial_dialogue: We can radio the fishing fleet, but they need about one and a half hours to get back to harbour.

npcs.name: Savita
npcs.initial_dialogue: My husband is still at sea and my father-in-law is bedridden. I cannot leave both.

npcs.name: Nurse Thomas
npcs.initial_dialogue: The cyclone shelter gets very crowded. We should plan for clean water and a medical camp.

npcs.name: Ms. Iyer
npcs.initial_dialogue: The state can send boats and relief, but roads will be cut once the wind rises.

scenarios.name: Below Kalindi Dam
scenarios.description: Heavy rain upstream forces a scheduled release from Kalindi Dam. The river below is already high. Timing and getting the message to every village decide the outcome.
scenarios.hook: The dam must release water in a few hours. Can you warn every village in time, and get the release slowed down?

npcs.name: Sarpanch Lakshmi
npcs.initial_dialogue: Many families here farm on the riverbank. If the dam opens without notice, they will be caught in the fields.

npcs.name: Constable Imran
npcs.initial_dialogue: We have three boats at the ghat and two jeeps. The low bridge to Temple Hamlet floods quickly.

npcs.name: Gopal
npcs.initial_dialogue: My mother cannot walk far. Will someone tell us before the water comes?

npcs.name: ASHA worker Meena
npcs.initial_dialogue: I know which houses have elderly people and pregnant women. They need to move first.

npcs.name: Mr. Kulkarni
npcs.initial_dialogue: The dam engineers must release water to keep the dam safe. They may agree to release it more slowly if we ask early.

scenarios.name: Glacial Lake Burst above Tsomo Valley
scenarios.description: Sensors on a glacial lake high above a mountain valley warn that its moraine wall may give way. If it bursts, a wall of water and debris reaches the valley within hours. Use the short warning window to move everyone uphill, then reopen the valley.
scenarios.hook: Lake sensors high above the valley just tripped. You have about two hours before a surge of water and boulders arrives.

npcs.name: Panchayat President Dorjee
npcs.initial_dialogue: Shopkeepers say the river is only a little higher than usual. They will not close the bazaar unless the warning is loud and clear.

npcs.name: Inspector Lhamu
npcs.initial_dialogue: Four trucks, one rubber raft. In a debris surge the raft is useless; the trucks are our real lifeline until the road goes.

npcs.name: Pemba
npcs.initial_dialogue: My grandmother is ninety and cannot climb the monastery steps. Please send a vehicle for the old people first.

npcs.name: Dr. Chettri
npcs.initial_dialogue: Cold nights on the ridge will be hard for babies and elders. We will need blankets, clean water and a medical camp.

npcs.name: Ms. Rai
npcs.initial_dialogue: The lake sensors sent an alarm. Cell broadcast is ready, but the decision to sound the sirens is yours.

shelters.name: Army Transit Camp on the Ridge

scenarios.name: Kamalpur Char: Island in the River
scenarios.description: A monsoon flood on a great braided river surrounds a sandbar island (a char). There are no roads to the mainland: every crossing needs a boat. Move the island families early, keep the ring bund standing, then bring everyone home.
scenarios.hook: Two hamlets sit on a sandbar in a swelling river. There is no road off the island, only boats, and the river rises every hour.

npcs.name: Gaon Burha Hemanta
npcs.initial_dialogue: Every monsoon the river eats a little more of our island. People will not leave their cattle and looms unless someone they trust asks them early.

npcs.name: Boatman Rafiq
npcs.initial_dialogue: Three country boats with engines are tied at the ghat. Each crossing takes time, and the current gets stronger as the river rises.

npcs.name: Jonali
npcs.initial_dialogue: My youngest has a fever and my mother-in-law cannot walk far. If the water reaches the courtyard we will be trapped.

npcs.name: ASHA worker Mamoni
npcs.initial_dialogue: After the water goes down, people drink from flooded hand pumps. We need chlorine tablets and a medical camp on the platform.

npcs.name: Mr. Bora
npcs.initial_dialogue: The district can send more boats and relief, but they come by road to the ghat first and then by water.

scenarios.name: Ward 14 Flash Flood
scenarios.description: A cloudburst over a city ward. Blocked drains and a railway underpass turn streets into channels within minutes. Act fast, then restore power, roads and safe water.
scenarios.hook: A cloudburst hits a dense city ward. Drains are blocked, the underpass fills first, and you have minutes, not hours.

npcs.name: Councillor Fatima
npcs.initial_dialogue: The drains behind the market are choked with plastic again. If the rain keeps up, the underpass will fill first.

npcs.name: Fire Officer Raju
npcs.initial_dialogue: We have two rescue dinghies and four trucks. Trucks cannot go through the underpass once water is above the kerb.

npcs.name: Anita
npcs.initial_dialogue: Our lane is already ankle-deep and my neighbour uses a wheelchair.

npcs.name: Dr. Mehta
npcs.initial_dialogue: Floodwater mixed with sewage is a serious risk. We will need clean water quickly afterwards.

npcs.name: Mr. Rao
npcs.initial_dialogue: The state response force can send boats, but they need a few hours to reach this ward.
